subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this umbrella stay open until maintainers resolve both the default-off `cron.minInterval` cadence guardrail and the isolated cron base-session retention cleanup semantics?
rationale: The source-backed gaps are real, but the remaining choices involve a new core config guardrail and compatibility-sensitive deletion or preservation of persisted cron session state.

options.title: Keep Open For Linked Decisions
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89739 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90194, then split any leftovers.

options.title: Split Remaining Work Now
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89666 canonical for retention and create a separate canonical item for cadence/context warnings before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Reject Core Guardrail Surface
options.body: If core should not own a cron cadence guardrail, close or narrow the guardrail PRs and leave only source-backed retention cleanup in scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Linked Decisions
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89739 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90194, then split any leftovers.
